/*selectSellerMpStToolStockStateList*/
SELECT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = F_GET_HIDDEN_BUYER_NAME(B.BUYER, '01')) AS BUYER_NAME , B.BUYER_ITEM_NO , B.DESCRIPTION , B.SPECIFICATION , B.UNIT_MEASURE , B.LIST_PRICE , B.MAKER_NAME , A.STOCK_QTY , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.CHANGE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS CHANGE_DATE , B.BUYER , B.CONTRACT_NO , B.CONTRACT_SEQ FROM KEP_S_STOCK A /* 구매대행재고수불 */ , ICOMCQDT B /* 구매사별 계약서 가격정보 */ WHERE 1=1 AND B.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND B.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.SELLER = B.AGENT AND B.S_STOCK_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D'
AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND B.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{st_description} || '%'
AND B.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_specification} || '%'
ORDER BY B.BUYER_ITEM_NO
